# Antigravity Open in Default App (`antigravity-open-default`)

> **跨平台 Antigravity 原生插件（macOS / Windows / Linux）**  
> 让 Antigravity 生成的 **HTML**、PDF、Office 文档、图片等结果文件，点一下直接用系统默认软件（Chrome / Edge / Safari / Preview 等）打开，或通过下拉菜单选择「打开方式」，不再跳进代码源码页。

A cross-platform **Google Antigravity** plugin (MCP App + Rule + PostToolUse Hook) that displays interactive launcher cards in chat and a side-pane file list so you can open generated `.html` pages and deliverables directly in your **OS default application** — or pick another installed app via **Open With** — instead of landing in the built-in code viewer.

---

## Features / 核心特性

* **One-Click Default App Launch（一键默认软件打开）**
  * Click the **filename** or **浏览器打开 / 默认软件打开** button to launch via native OS handlers:
    * **macOS**: `/usr/bin/open`
    * **Windows**: PowerShell `Start-Process` (with env-var path passing — safe for spaces, CJK characters, and special symbols)
    * **Linux**: `xdg-open`
* **Native "Open With" Dropdown（选择打开方式）**
  * Click the **`▾`** split-button arrow to open a vertical dropdown showing the **top 5** compatible apps installed on your machine (browsers prioritized for `.html`), with a **"选择更多应用…"** toggle for the rest:
    * **macOS**: Queries `NSWorkspace` / LaunchServices dynamically (auto-filters nested helpers and updater duplicates)
    * **Windows**: Queries Windows Registry (`UserChoice`, `OpenWithProgids`, `OpenWithList`, `StartMenuInternet`) dynamically
* **Reveal in Finder / File Explorer & Back to Source（定位文件 / 切回源码）**
  * **Finder** (macOS) / **资源管理器** (Windows): highlights the file directly (`open -R` / `explorer.exe /select,"..."`).
  * **源码**: opens Antigravity's built-in file viewer (`fileView`) whenever you do want to inspect source code.
* **Batch Anti-Spam Protection（批量防刷屏）**
  * Always-on rule enforces **at most 1 card per turn** and prioritizes entry-point files (e.g., `index.html`).
  * Lists with **> 3 files** automatically prioritize `.html` files and collapse to the top 3 with an expandable **"展开其余 N 个文件"** toggle.
  * Lists with **> 5 files** replace **"全部打开"** with **"打开所在目录"** so you never accidentally pop open 20 tabs at once.
* **Side Pane Launcher（右侧栏「系统外开文件」）**
  * Open from Antigravity's side pane **`+`** menu → **系统外开文件**.
  * A silent `PostToolUse` hook automatically tracks generated `.html`, `.pdf`, Office docs, and images across all conversations without ever stealing window focus.
  * Includes search, category filters (`HTML` / `文档` / `图片` / `其他`), quick path open, and directory scan.
* **Safe by Design（安全机制）**
  * All launch/reveal tools use `visibility: ["app"]` — **only user clicks** in the UI can invoke them; the LLM cannot execute arbitrary launches directly.
  * Zero shell interpolation; blocks direct execution of executable/script file types (`.exe`, `.bat`, `.cmd`, `.ps1`, `.vbs`, `.js`, `.sh`, `.app`, `.command`, `.dmg`, `.pkg`, etc.).

---

## Installation / 安装方式

Antigravity automatically discovers plugins placed under `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` (macOS/Linux) or `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\` (Windows). No app restart is required; tools and rules activate on your next message.

### macOS / Linux

```bash
git clone https://github.com/wuying1991/antigravity-open-default.git \
  ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-open-default
cd ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-open-default
npm install --omit=dev
```

### Windows (PowerShell)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/wuying1991/antigravity-open-default.git `
  "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-open-default"
Set-Location "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-open-default"
npm install --omit=dev
```

> **Note on Node runtime**: `mcp_config.json` uses Antigravity's built-in cross-platform `agy-node` runtime, so it works reliably on both macOS and Windows even when system `node` is not in the GUI `PATH`. You only need `npm` once to install the 3 runtime dependencies (`@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`, `@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps`, `zod`). Pre-built UI bundles (`dist/card.html`, `dist/pane.html`) are included in the repository.

---

## Usage / 使用方法

1. Ask Antigravity in **any conversation** to generate an `.html` page (or PDF, chart, spreadsheet, etc.).
2. At the end of the reply, an inline **Open in Default App** card appears automatically:
   * Click the **filename** or **浏览器打开 / 默认软件打开** → opens in your OS default app.
   * Click **`▾`** → pick any of the top 5 installed apps, or expand to view all compatible apps.
   * Click **Finder** / **资源管理器** → reveals the file on disk.
   * Click **源码** → opens the file in Antigravity's built-in code viewer.
3. Click **`+`** in Antigravity's right auxiliary pane → select **系统外开文件** anytime to browse, filter, and reopen recent outputs across conversations.
4. Manage, toggle, or uninstall anytime in Antigravity's **Customizations → Plugins** page.

---

## Development & Testing / 本地开发与测试

```bash
npm install
npm run build   # Rebuild self-contained dist/card.html and dist/pane.html
npm test        # Run cross-platform unit tests, hook test, and MCP stdio E2E test
```

### Project Layout

```text
antigravity-open-default/
├── plugin.json           # Antigravity plugin manifest
├── mcp_config.json       # Cross-platform MCP server launch config (agy-node)
├── hooks.json            # Silent PostToolUse deliverable tracker
├── rules/AGENTS.md       # Always-on rule (HTML-first, 1 card/turn anti-spam)
├── hooks/track-output.mjs
├── src/
│   ├── platform.mjs      # macOS / Windows / Linux launch, reveal, and Open With discovery
│   ├── store.mjs         # Persistent recent file history and metadata enrichment
│   ├── server.mjs        # MCP stdio server & MCP App tool/resource registration
│   ├── card-ui.js        # Inline MCP App card UI
│   ├── pane-ui.js        # Side-pane MCP App launcher UI
│   └── styles.css        # Native Antigravity light/dark theme variables
├── dist/
│   ├── card.html         # Self-contained inline card bundle
│   └── pane.html         # Self-contained side-pane bundle
├── build.mjs             # Zero-binary HTML single-file builder
└── test/smoke.test.mjs   # End-to-end verification suite
```
